name: Internal Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that internal sin originates in the heart and mind, not merely in outward actions. Jesus teaches that lustful thoughts are equivalent to adultery committed inwardly, emphasizing the seriousness of sin within (Matthew 5:28). Moreover, the defilement of a person stems from what proceeds from the heart, highlighting the internal source of moral corruption (Matthew 15:18). Believers are called to be transformed through the renewal of their minds, demonstrating that victory over internal sin requires a profound spiritual change aligned with God's will (Romans 12:2).
